finding.rationale: Site enumeration via GET /sites?search=* maps every SharePoint Online site collection (id, displayName, webUrl), giving an adversary a target list of repositories to collect from — site names alone (e.g. HR-Compensation, Legal-Contracts) expose business function. A Conditional Access policy requiring a compliant/managed app or device for SharePoint Online blocks the borrowed first-party FOCI client (14d82eec) running on an unmanaged host from reaching site data, cutting the technique off at the authorization boundary. Evidenced in R013: after the W17 sharingCapability $select defect was fixed (Tool 14 re-scoped to site enumeration), GET /sites?search=* returned the tenant's SharePoint site inventory, confirming the technique against the sandbox. Note: per-site external-sharing posture is not available via the Graph site object, so it is not part of this surface.
